post-intervention-response: Oh, um, well, long conversations with strangers can be a bit... overwhelming for me, you know? I get all nervous and I'm not always sure what to say. It's just safer that way, I guess. I admire people who can just chat away with anyone, though. It's just not something I'm very comfortable with.
